facts.material: Lexan (polycarbonate) plastic housing; cast aluminum bracket
facts.function: external housing/shell of a traffic signal; bracket attaches the traffic light
facts.form: separate parts of traffic signal equipment

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8530 covers electrical signaling/traffic control equipment for roads and parts thereof

Section XVI note 2(b): parts suitable solely or principally for a particular kind of machine follow that machine; note 1(g) excludes parts of general use (base metal, plastics) but a signal-specific housing is not general use

rejected_alternatives.reason: general plastic articles; housing is a dedicated part of traffic signal equipment and heading 8530 covers parts
base metal mounting for the aluminum bracket, the second-named article (classify separately); first-named housing governs here
vehicle signaling equipment; traffic signals for roads are heading 8530

missing_facts: classify separately: cast aluminum bracket (possibly 8302 if a general mounting, or 8530.90 if a dedicated signal part)
classification.rationale: The Lexan housing is a part dedicated to traffic signal equipment, so under Section XVI note 2(b) and heading 8530 (parts thereof) it is 8530.90.00.00. No on-point ruling was found.
